entities.name: Lucilde Fiksdotter
entities.description: Leader of the Order of the White Shield, Kjeldoran knights fighting Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Goddess of the thawing World Spell and the song of Freyalise.

entities.name: Disa the Restless
entities.description: Explorer who returned from a disastrous voyage and later fought the dead.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: City the group was traveling to.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: Halvor's protegee who bore the mark of the Elder Druid.

entities.name: Kolbjörn
entities.description: Elder Druid who lives with elves in Fyndhorn.

entities.name: Avram Garrisson
entities.description: Order of Stromgald knight who allied with Lim-Dûl and became undead.

events.summary: Lucilde and Klazina wait two weeks for Disa to return from her expedition.
events.quote: remained at a mountain pass for two weeks

events.summary: A storm forces the three to shelter in Mikkel's church, where Halvor and Kaysa celebrate the Feast of Kjeld.
events.quote: forced to seek refuge in the village of Mikkel

events.summary: Kolbjörn arrives to take Kaysa to Fyndhorn and Halvor objects.
events.quote: Kolbjörn announced that he had come to take Kaysa

events.summary: Avram Garrisson arrives and reveals he has allied with Lim-Dûl and become undead.
events.quote: Avram revealed that he had allied himself with Lim-Dul, becoming undead

events.summary: The undead villagers break in; the group fights, and Kolbjörn and Kaysa's song of Freyalise strips the undead of life.
events.quote: all the undead were stripped of their unholy life, thus saving the group

events.summary: Halvor lets Kaysa go with Kolbjörn; Lucilde and Klazina bury the villagers and find Avram's corpse missing.
events.quote: Avram's corpse was not among the bodies

relations.quote: was the leader of the Order of the White Shield
fought the forces of the necromancer Lim-Dûl
he had allied himself with Lim-Dul
a knight of the Order of Stromgald
